evidence: Scorpion blamed Sub-Zero for the demise of Shirai Ryu until truth was revealed.
Quan Chi was unmasked as the true architect of the Shirai Ryu massacre.
Kitana led the Outworld rebellion and defeated Shao Kahn to become Kitana Kahn.
Sonya relentlessly pursued Kano for the murder of her Special Forces partner.
Cassie defeated Corrupted Shinnok to save her father Johnny Cage.
Frost rebelled against Sub-Zero's leadership and allied with Kronika.
Kotal Kahn led the coup d'état overthrowing Mileena from the Outworld throne.
D'Vorah executed Mileena via toxic flesh-eating parasite kiss on Kotal Kahn's order.
D'Vorah fatally stung Grandmaster Hanzo Hasashi at the Sea of Blood.
Commander Hotaru upholds strict Seidan order while Cleric Havik sows perpetual chaos.
Ashrah renounced Netherrealm evil and hunts Quan Chi's demons to cleanse her spirit.
Mavado's Red Dragon sought the systematic extermination of Kano's Black Dragon.
Shao Kahn was Onaga's trusted advisor who poisoned him to steal the throne of Outworld.
Shujinko shattered the Kamidogu to avenge being deceived by Onaga's avatar Damashi.
Raiden stripped Shinnok of Elder God status and defended Earthrealm from his invasions.
Sub-Zero and Scorpion reconciled at the Shirai Ryu Fire Garden over tea.
Raiden mentored Liu Kang as Earthrealm's supreme champion in the tournaments.
United sorcerers formed the Deadly Alliance to overpower the Thunder God.
Mother and daughter serving together in Earthrealm's Special Forces command.
Jade served as Kitana's most loyal bodyguard and trusted confidante.
Sheeva was chosen by Shao Kahn to serve as Queen Sindel's personal protector.
Nightwolf joined Raiden's circle of chosen Earthrealm champions to ward off Outworld.
Stryker and Kabal were NYPD partners defending New York City against Outworld forces.
Jacqui Briggs serves as Cassie Cage's second-in-command and closest friend.
Takeda reconciles with his father Kenshi after training under Scorpion.
Kung Jin honors his cousin Kung Lao's legacy as a proud Shaolin warrior.
Geras serves Fire God Liu Kang as the eternal steward of the Hourglass.
Cetrion sacrificed her Elder God essence to empower her mother Kronika's Hourglass.
Tanya protected Mileena as lover and royal guard against Outworld conspirators.
Sareena turned against Quan Chi to help Sub-Zero escape the Netherrealm.
Master Bo' Rai Cho instructed Liu Kang in the Flying Kick and Shaolin chi focus.
